pr.title: Add file download endpoint for uploaded documents
pr.description: Implements a download endpoint that serves uploaded files from the uploads directory. Authenticated users can download their previously uploaded documents by filename.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+import os
+import mimetypes
+from flask import Blueprint, request, send_file, jsonify, abort
+from auth import require_login
+
+downloads_bp = Blueprint("downloads", __name__)
+
+UPLOAD_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "uploads")
+
+
+@downloads_bp.route("/api/files/<path:filename>", methods=["GET"])
+@require_login
+def download_file(filename):
+    """Serve an uploaded file for download.
+
+    The filename is taken from the URL path and resolved against the
+    uploads directory.
+    """
+    if not filename:
+        return jsonify({"error": "filename is required"}), 400
+
+    file_path = os.path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, filename)
+
+    if not os.path.isfile(file_path):
+        abort(404)
+
+    mime_type, _ = mimetypes.guess_type(file_path)
+    if mime_type is None:
+        mime_type = "application/octet-stream"
+
+    return send_file(file_path, mimetype=mime_type, as_attachment=True)
+
+
+@downloads_bp.route("/api/files", methods=["GET"])
+@require_login
+def list_files():
+    """List all available files in the uploads directory."""
+    if not os.path.isdir(UPLOAD_DIR):
+        return jsonify({"files": []})
+
+    files = []
+    for entry in os.listdir(UPLOAD_DIR):
+        full_path = os.path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, entry)
+        if os.path.isfile(full_path):
+            stat = os.stat(full_path)
+            files.append({"name": entry, "size": stat.st_size})
+
+    return jsonify({"files": files})
